title: BIOS and firmware baseline
content:
# BIOS and firmware baseline

## Firmware

Update in this order: iDRAC and Lifecycle Controller, then BIOS, then everything else (network, storage, power supplies). Use **Maintenance → System Update** in the iDRAC web interface, or upload a Dell Update Package:

```
racadm update -f <UPDATE-PACKAGE>.EXE
```

| Component | Approved version | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| iDRAC with Lifecycle Controller | 7.x (example) | Always first |
| BIOS | 1.x (example) | Requires a reboot |
| Network adapter | site baseline (example) | Same version on both servers at a site |
| Storage controller | site baseline (example) | Check after every BIOS update |

## BIOS settings

| Setting | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Boot mode | UEFI |
| Secure Boot | Enabled |
| System profile | Performance |
| Virtualization technology | Enabled |
| AC power recovery | Last state |

Example of changing the system profile with `racadm` (the change is applied by a job at the next reboot):

```
racadm get BIOS.SysProfileSettings.SysProfile
racadm set BIOS.SysProfileSettings.SysProfile PerfOptimized
racadm jobqueue create BIOS.Setup.1-1
racadm serveraction powercycle
```
